verdict.rationale: Enterprise drop-shipping of keys to distributed employees is a fair question for a hardware security key vendor, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Google offering an API- or console-driven delivery service for Titan keys. The probe says Titan ships no API of its own and routes fleet management through the separate Google Workspace Admin console. Community reports describe only a manual chat-and-RMA replacement process.

support.subject: As an IT admin, an enterprise delivery service ships keys directly to distributed employees, driven by an API or console rather than manual logistics
